title: Renewable Netherite & Diamonds
description: Adds the ability to renew Netherite and Diamonds in case you've mined out your entire world.
body:
# Renewable Netherite and Diamonds
Made by [**8bitdino**](https://www.youtube.com/@8bitdino) with **100% human** trial & error :3
## Description
Adds very inconvenient ways to make Netherite Ingots, Scrap, and Diamonds renewable!

This is designed to work with my [Better Non-Renewables Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/uglZSVKi)!
## Affected Items
- Netherite Ingot
- Netherite Scrap
- Diamonds
## Recipes Added
These are designed to be more inconvenient/tedious than getting Diamonds/Netherite the traditional way.
## More
I haven't figured out a good way to make modular datapacks, so don't be afraid to go into the file and delete any .json files in the [recipe] folder you don't want!

Please let me know if any bugs/issues arise by submitting a report through the dedicated [Google Form](https://forms.gle/UnCkA96xm5q3CV6a8)!
## Credits
